actions.action: Squeeze the base of the trunk monthly to check firmness
If the trunk is soft, stop watering and take the plant out of its pot
If rot is only at the base, cut off the healthy top of the cane with a sterilized saw
Let the cut cane callus for 2 days, then repot it in fresh soil
Move the plant against the brightest south- or west-facing window
Check moisture at the bottom of the pot with a wooden stick or moisture meter
When bone dry, water heavily until it drains from the holes
Repot in a mix of 50% potting soil and 50% coarse sand, pumice and perlite
Trim yellow or brown lower leaves cleanly at the base with scissors

verdict.reason: The answer blames overwatering and low light and says underwatering is almost impossible, which misses the confirmed underwatering, and its advice to water less and let the soil dry fully would likely worsen this plant.
